segments.text: 🎯 GATE 6 — Day 145 · MOCK #11: Google Drive / Collaborative Docs।
What: The Phase 6 checkpoint, and the last of the "harder" product systems — a mock on real-time sync and conflict resolution under pressure.
How to complete: Sit the mock cold, timed to 45 minutes, then score yourself against: sync protocol, conflict resolution, CRDT/OT, versioning.

Don't move on until you can truthfully check off:
No common FAANG design question is unfamiliar territory
